message.content:
This is granite slabs, polished, which falls under heading 6802. Heading 6802 covers worked monumental or building stone, and subheading 6802.93 covers granite, other than slate, polished or otherwise worked.

The slabs are cut to rectangular shape and polished, but they will be cut further after importation. CBP rulings on similar granite slabs generally classify them in 6802.93. Within that subheading, 6802.93.00 splits into statistical suffixes: 6802.93.0010 for "Slabs", 6802.93.0090 for "Other" (the 6802.93 suffixes were revised over time). Older versions of 6802.93.00 had: 10 = Granite slabs, 6802.93.0090 = Other. The current version has 6802.93.00 with the 10 suffix for "Slabs, and other: Polished". I'm not certain of the current wording, but I'll go with 6802.93.0010.

An alternative is 6802.23 (granite, simply cut or sawn with a flat surface), but the polishing excludes it. The polished top and sides and beveled edges mean the stone is further worked than merely cut, so 6802.93 applies.
